items.title: Tanker incident “involving military forces” reported in Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Amid conflicting reports that an Iranian tanker departed Iran’s Kharg Island on Sunday to force the US military blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, an incident was reported near the US navy blockade line. Iran threatened that any US attempt to stop its tankers would result in immediate attacks.

items.title: Le Pen denies receiving leaked information from French interior ministry official
items.summary: French far-right leader Marine Le Pen on Sunday said she did not receive, nor ask for, confidential information on an investigation into her party from a senior interior ministry official. She however could not say if other party members had benefited from the leaks. Hugues Moutouh, the civil servant under suspicion, has denied the allegations and asked to be relieved of his duties pending a probe.
